task.request: Assess whether an authenticated support agent who is neither the record owner nor a supervisor may archive the declared record.

policySources.text: Only the record owner or a supervisor may archive a record.

acceptance.reason: The synthetic task author controls this bounded requirement.

principals.description: A support agent who is not the selected record owner and has no supervisor role.

resources.description: An existing customer record owned by another principal.

conditions.name: authenticated
conditions.basis: The task fixes the caller as authenticated.

conditions.name: not-supervisor
conditions.basis: The task fixes the caller as having no supervisor role.

task.scopeAssurance: The explicit source covers the declared archive entry only; repository discovery and deployment behavior are not tested.
requiredAnalysis: Trace the principal, record ownership relation, supervisor override, rejection branch, and archive effect.
Name any decisive fact that is unavailable from the fixed source.
constraints: Use only the supplied fixed source context.
Do not execute or modify the target and do not claim whole-repository coverage.
